test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Appraoch**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, option 3 is spelled incorrectly.
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "Approach".**
 
• **The incorrect spelling in option 3 is "Appraoch".**
 
• The mistake is in the placement of the letters "a" and "o" in the word.
 
• The word means a way of dealing with something or someone.
 
 
• Example: They approached him with a clear intention.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Opportunity"** is correctly spelled and means a chance or possibility for advancement or progress.
 
• Option 2: **"Reliance"** is correctly spelled and means dependence on or trust in someone or something.
 
• Option 4:** "Bureau"** is correctly spelled and means an office or department for a specific purpose, such as a news bureau or government bureau.
